scenario.task:
Je veux transférer mon numéro de téléphone fixe résidentiel vers ma nouvelle ligne mobile

User Guide: The user speaks Canadian French. They want to move their home phone number to a mobile SIM. They will verify their identity and provide the details to start the transfer If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
